label: peak_solar

solver.buoyancy_model: full buoyancy, incompressible ideal gas at the site pressure
solver.radiation_model: none, surfaces held at the EnergyPlus inside face temperatures

notes: The solver did not meet its convergence criteria. Treat this field as unconverged and do not quote numbers from it.
Every grid point carries the value of the nearest solver cell. Grid points farther from any cell than the local cell spacing lie outside the air volume and are left empty rather than filled.
The surfaces were held at the inside face temperatures EnergyPlus reported for peak solar at 2019-01-24T15:00:00.

Convergence was judged on the solution rather than on scaled residuals, which plateau for air moved only by surface temperature differences: the volume average air temperature is still drifting, 0.092 K between the last two windows of 350 iterations.
Volume average air temperature 7.86 C against the 8.69 C EnergyPlus reported for the room as one well mixed volume.
The internal convective gain, infiltration and interzone mixing heat flows were applied as one uniform volumetric source totalling 496.1 W, so where leaks or occupants actually sit is not resolved.

source.citation: ANSYS Fluent 2026 R1, k-omega SST, 205,296 cells, run on the boundary conditions EnergyPlus exported for peak solar
